# Decision Records

Numbered decision records for `see-through-verify`, the verified Lean-Slang
reimplementation of the `weftspun/see-through-cpp` diffusion pipeline.

The project decomposes a single anime illustration into semantically layered
PSD output (anime illustration → layered PSD). It reimplements the original
ggml/C++ pipeline with verified GPU compute: every kernel is authored in Slang
and exported to C++ via `slangc -target cpp`, then validated against ggml
oracle taps — no hand-coded C++.
